question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH views AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
add_to_cart AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND e.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) 
      AND e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) 
      AND e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3
      )
    GROUP BY p.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.page_name as product_name,
    v.view_count,
    a.add_to_cart_count,
    l.left_in_cart_count,
    p2.purchase_count
FROM views v
JOIN add_to_cart a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN left_in_cart l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN purchases p2 ON v.product_id = p2.product_id
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY p.product_id
